王铁柱被王野这么一问直接愣住了：“什么工资？”

王野着急的解释道：“我上个月的工资，赵爷爷说你领走了。”

王铁柱：“哦哦哦，你的工资呀，给你娘了。”

王野想都没想：“你怎么给我娘了呀？”

王铁柱好气的骂道：“这不是废话吗，我的工资都给你娘了，你的能留下呀？”

王野转头又向门口跑去，看见秦婉正在和院里的人聊天。谄媚的蹲在秦婉旁边问道：“娘～，我爹是不是把我的工资给你了？”

秦婉理直气壮的回道：“是啊，怎么了？”

王野硬着头皮小声的问：“娘，工资可以给我不？”

秦婉疑惑的问：“怎么，你缺钱了？”

王野：“不缺呀？”

秦婉扭过头去：“不缺，你要什么工资，都给你给存着呢，等娶媳妇儿时用”。

王野赶紧说道：“娘，娘咱从下个月在存老婆本儿行不？这回的工资就给我吧。”

秦婉又把头转回来疑惑的问：“为什么呀，你到底要工资干什么呀？”

王野：“我要做个相框，把这一个月的工资裱起来。”

秦婉伸手摸了摸王野的额头，不相信似的又摸摸自己的：“不发烧呀，怎么说胡话呀？”

王野：“娘，我没发烧，你想呀，这是我挣得第一份工资，多有纪念意义呀，这要是等我老了看着这个相框得多幸福呀。”

秦婉品味着王野的话，虽然觉得他是歪理，但是细想下还有点道理。看着大儿子那期待的眼神，秦婉只能妥协道：“行行行，一会儿回去我就给你。”

这时在不远处玩儿的王笑笑听见了秦婉的话，倒腾的两条小短腿儿跑过来，站在王野身边对着秦婉拍着小肚子：“我，我，我要。”

门口的人都被这小丫头逗笑了，秦婉伸手点着王笑笑的脑袋：“你听见什么了，就你要，你要。”

王笑笑有王野站台语调都硬气：“就要，就要。”

这一下门口的人被逗得更受不了了，一个个笑的前仰后合的。秦婉笑骂道：“哪儿都有你个小丫头片子，滚蛋。”

王野目的达到了，抱起小丫头就进院了。不远处王江河看见大哥抱着妹妹进了院子，他也赶紧跟上。王野快到赵爷爷门口时回头看见了这小子，看他欲言又止的样子就问：“怎么了，有事儿？”

王江河咽了口口水，好像下了很大的决心才问道：“大哥，你给妹妹的小瓶瓶还有吗？”

王野：“你要那瓶子干什么呀？”

Wang Tiezhu was stunned when Wang Ye asked: "What salary?"

Wang Ye explained anxiously: "Grandpa Zhao said you took my salary last month."

Wang Tiezhu: "Oh oh oh, your salary goes to your mother."

Wang Ye didn't even think about it: "Why did you give it to my mother?"

Wang Tiezhu scolded angrily: "Isn't this nonsense? My salary has been given to your mother, can you keep yours?"

Wang Ye turned around and ran towards the door again, and saw Qin Wan chatting with people in the courtyard.She knelt down next to Qin Wan flatteringly and asked, "Mom, did my father give you my salary?"

Qin Wan replied confidently: "Yes, what's wrong?"

Wang Ye forced himself to ask in a low voice: "Mom, can you give me your salary?"

Qin Wan asked doubtfully: "What, are you short of money?"

Wang Ye: "Isn't there any shortage?"

Qin Wan turned her head and said, "It's not lacking. Whatever salary you want, I'll save it for you to use when you get a wife."

Wang Ye quickly said: "Mom, can we save money for my wife from next month? Just give me the salary this time."

Qin Wan turned her head back and asked doubtfully: "Why? What on earth do you need your salary for?"

Wang Ye: "I want to make a photo frame to frame this month's salary."

Qin Wan reached out and touched Wang Ye's forehead, then touched her own as if she didn't believe him: "You don't have a fever, why are you talking nonsense?"

Wang Ye: "Mom, I don't have a fever. Think about it, this is the first salary I have earned. How memorable it is. How happy I will be when I look at this photo frame when I am old."

Qin Wan tasted Wang Ye's words. Although she thought he was unreasonable, there was some truth in it after thinking about it carefully.Seeing the expectant look in her eldest son's eyes, Qin Wan could only compromise: "Okay, okay, I'll give it to you when I get back soon."

At this time, Wang Xiaoxiao, who was playing not far away, heard Qin Wan's words, ran over with two short legs, stood beside Wang Ye and patted Qin Wan's belly: "I, I, I want it."

Everyone at the door was amused by this little girl. Qin Wan reached out and nodded Wang Xiaoxiao's head: "What did you hear? It's all you want, you want it."

Both Wang Xiaoxiao and Wang Ye spoke forcefully on the platform: "Yes, yes."

This time, the people at the door were even more amused, and they were all laughing.Qin Wan laughed and scolded: "There are movies of you little girl everywhere, get out of here."

Wang Ye achieved his goal, picked up the little girl and entered the hospital.Not far away, Wang Jianghe saw his elder brother carrying his sister into the yard, and he quickly followed.When Wang Ye was approaching Grandpa Zhao's door, he turned around and saw this boy. Seeing that he was hesitant to speak, he asked, "What's the matter? Is something wrong?"

Wang Jianghe swallowed and seemed to have made a lot of determination before asking: "Brother, do you still have the vials you gave to my sister?"

Wang Ye: "What do you want that bottle for?"
